title: Coven automation occurrence (coven.automations.occurrence.v1)
description: One ledger row of scheduled work. The UNIQUE(automationId, scheduledFor) fence makes planning idempotent across ticks, replicas, and restarts; exactly one dispatch may exist per fence.

id.description: Deterministic fence id: automationId + '-' + epoch millis of scheduledFor.

scheduledFor.description: RFC3339 UTC instant of the scheduled slot, millisecond precision.

state.description: planned -> claimed -> running -> succeeded|failed; expired leases recover to failed; exhausted retries quarantine. succeeded and failed are terminal and monotonic.
